source: Adjust smoothness, horizon lock and how much the frame is cropped.
zh: 调整平滑度、地平线锁定，以及画面裁切的程度。

source: Batch processing of multiple videos happens here. Right-click a video and choose "Edit" to load it into the main preview and check the result.
zh: 批量处理多个视频都在这里进行。右键某个视频选「Edit」（编辑），把它载入主预览查看稳定效果。

source: Batch processing of multiple videos happens here. Right-click a video for "Deep match with gyro" (finds the offset when the gyro is a separate file) or "Edit" (loads it into the main preview to check the result).
zh: 批量处理多个视频都在这里进行。右键某个视频可选「Deep match with gyro」（陀螺在单独文件、时间对不齐时自动找偏移）或「Edit」（载入主预览查看稳定效果）。

source: Click "Export stabilized video" to render the result, or "Export for plugins" to produce a project file for the editor plugins.
zh: 点「导出稳定视频」渲染成片；或用「导出（搭配插件使用）」生成工程文件，配合剪辑软件插件使用。

source: Click "Open file" (top-left) to pick the clip you want to stabilize. You can select several at once. Most cameras embed gyro data in the video, so it is detected automatically.
zh: 点左上角「打开文件」选择要稳定的视频。可一次多选。大多数相机的陀螺仪数据已嵌在视频里，会被自动识别。

source: Configure the lens and sensor so lens distortion is corrected correctly for your footage.
zh: 配置镜头和传感器信息，让画面畸变得到正确矫正。

source: Deep match
zh: 深度匹配

source: Drag a video into the main window or the render queue, or click "Open file" (top-left). Most cameras embed gyro data, so it is detected automatically.
zh: 把视频拖进主窗口或渲染队列，或点左上角「打开文件」。大多数相机的陀螺仪数据已嵌在视频里，会被自动识别。

source: Editor plugins
zh: 安装插件

source: Install the Gyroflow plugin into your editor (Premiere, DaVinci Resolve and more) to stabilize on the timeline.
zh: 把 Gyroflow 插件安装到你的剪辑软件（Premiere、DaVinci Resolve 等），即可在时间线上稳定。

source: Lens groups
zh: 镜头组数据

source: Load your video
zh: 加载视频

source: Open Settings
zh: 打开设置

source: Other settings
zh: 其他设置

source: Output folder access denied — enable Gyroflow in Settings → Files and Folders.
zh: 输出文件夹访问被拒绝 — 请在 设置 → 文件和文件夹 中允许 Gyroflow。

source: Pick any video in the render queue, right-click and choose "Edit" to load it into the main preview and check the stabilization in real time.
zh: 在渲染队列里随机选一个视频，右键选择「Edit」（编辑），把它载入主预览，实时查看稳定效果。

source: Please enable folder access permission.
zh: 请打开文件夹访问权限

source: Preview the result
zh: 预览效果

source: Replay tutorial
zh: 重新观看教程

source: Run into a bug? Click here to upload logs and send us feedback.
zh: 遇到问题？点这里上传日志并反馈给我们。

source: Sensor and lens
zh: 传感器与镜头

source: Set how the camera was mounted (a wrong orientation corrects the wrong way), then pick the lens group so distortion is corrected correctly.
zh: 设置相机的安装方向（方向选错会让稳定往反方向纠），再选择镜头组让画面畸变得到正确矫正。

source: Set the mounting orientation
zh: 设置安装方向

source: Tell Gyroflow how the camera was mounted. A wrong orientation makes stabilization correct the wrong way.
zh: 告诉软件相机是怎么安装的。方向选错会让稳定往反方向纠。

source: Use this button to show or hide the render queue. Batch processing of multiple videos all happens in the queue.
zh: 用这个按钮展开或收起渲染队列。批量处理多个视频都在队列里进行。

source: When the gyro data is in a separate file and the timing does not line up, right-click a video in the render queue and choose "Deep match with gyro" to find the offset automatically.
zh: 当陀螺仪数据在单独的文件里、且时间对不齐时，在渲染队列里右键某个视频，选择「Deep match with gyro」自动找到时间偏移。

source: Back
zh: 上一步

source: Done
zh: 完成

source: Next
zh: 下一步

source: Skip
zh: 跳过
